name: BRIEF-001 tracked concept vehicle assembly benchmark
description: Brief-driven hierarchical CAD benchmark for decomposing a compact tracked concept vehicle into editable atomic parts, mid-level subassemblies, and a recognizable final assembly.

tasks.prompt: Create a compact tracked concept vehicle as an editable CAD assembly. It should have a lower hull, left and right track modules, multiple road wheels, an upper body, and a top turret or sensor module. The final object should read clearly as a tracked vehicle from 3D inspection. Keep it parametric and organized into reusable parts/subassemblies.
assumptions: This benchmark evaluates hierarchy and recognizability rather than a single precise drawing reconstruction.
The object is a non-weaponized compact tracked robotic platform with a top sensor module.
The initial evaluator uses existing geometry/topology checks; assembly-specific semantic checks are proposed under cobra/evaluator_rules.
